title: Limits of Resolution in Quantum Machine Learning: A Noise Budget for Small Benchmarks
description: Code, spatiotemporal panel data checkpoints, and statistical evaluation scripts accompanying the paper 'Limits of Resolution in Quantum Machine Learning: A Noise Budget for Small Benchmarks'. The repository provides complete reproducibility artifacts for decomposing AUC comparisons into test-set sampling error (DeLong and calendar-year block bootstrap) versus parameter optimization-seed variance on a multi-decadal Western Mediterranean precipitation panel (1938-2026).
